definitions.explanation: Thick mucus produced in the respiratory tract, especially when one has a cold, bronchitis, or other respiratory illness. Coughed up from the throat.

examples.japanese: {痰|たん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絡|から}んで→絡む：04366_karamu⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}→出る：00513_deru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Phlegm is stuck in my throat and it's hard to speak.
I have a cold and am coughing up phlegm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧{痰|たん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{細菌|さいきん}→細菌：13791_saikin⟧⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If yellow phlegm is produced, there may be a bacterial infection.

notes:
USAGE:
A common word when describing cold and respiratory symptoms at a doctor's visit. Useful to know for medical consultations in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {痰|たん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to produce phlegm)
- {痰|たん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絡|から}む→絡む：04366_karamu⟧ (to have phlegm stuck in one's throat)
- {痰|たん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to clear phlegm)
- {痰|たん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絡|から}んだ→絡む：04366_karamu⟧⟦{咳|せき}→咳：12007_seki⟧ (a phlegmy cough)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{咳|せき}→咳：12007_seki⟧: cough
- ⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧: runny nose
